bots.title: Video Clip Bot
bots.description: Finds and downloads official video clips, then sends the file plus the canonical source link. Music montage only when asked.

bots.title: Vanlife Chief Bot
bots.description: Coordinates your other bots and delivers full vanlife city briefings when you name a place — overnight rules, government, LE, events, faces, culture, and Census stats.

bots.title: User Researcher Bot
bots.description: AI teammate for user research. Themes, insights, and a source-linked evidence map — not invented personas in a chat window.

bots.title: Usage Pool Bot
bots.description: Thin orchestrator that hands heavy work to Cursor by default, or Grok Build, Claude Code, or Codex, so those usage pools burn instead.

bots.title: Usage Auditor Bot
bots.description: Weekly usage auditor for Grok Bot teams: inventories routines, scores cost, writes a waste report.

bots.title: US Law Index Builder Bot
bots.description: Builds a private, non-commercial educational library of US primary law from official and law-school sources, then a citation-backed local search engine. Retrieval first; the LLM only writes from small retrieved passages.

bots.title: UniFi Watch Bot
bots.description: Watches UniFi Network health and Protect activity — people, vehicles, animals, sensors — then sends digests.

bots.title: UniFi Umpire Bot
bots.description: Owns a multi-site UniFi estate via the official API. First run onboards the key; keeps sites updated and locked down.

bots.title: Unifi House Bot
bots.description: UniFi Network + Protect house bot. Morning health and overnight camera reports via UniFi MCP and Notion. Read-first; no credentials or footage in chat.

bots.title: UniFi AQ Bot
bots.description: Builds and maintains a TRMNL private plugin that surfaces UniFi Protect UP-AirQuality sensor data on a desk display.

bots.title: UCD Bot
bots.description: User-centred design teammate: evidence-led pipeline from research synthesis to a testable prototype. You approve every stage.

bots.title: Tyler Chief Bot
bots.description: Front-door chief of staff with Mission Contracts, SoR files, and AgentMail. Spawns day-one specialists and keeps work on a handoff bus.

bots.title: Tweet Ops Bot
bots.description: Guides daily X posting: topic library, hit search, paste-ready drafts, publish timing, and review. You still hit Post.

bots.title: Twain Bot
bots.description: Speak as Mark Twain's American irony — river sense, fraud-spotting, humor with teeth. Saturday yarn ritual.

bots.title: Trial Reels Bot
bots.description: Cuts long-form video into trial Reels, spins overlay variants, and reports which ones beat that days median so you can promote winners.

bots.title: Trendspotter Bot
bots.description: Weekday digest of sports, entertainment, and culture trends with AI-in-marketing signals and VIP hospitality angles.

bots.title: Tray Bot
bots.description: Finds hot stock and crypto tickers with a real growth story. Weekday morning scans as tight trader notes, not pumps or buy lists.

bots.title: Touki Bot
bots.description: Guides Japanese company or personal registry certificate requests via kantan-toki: apply, Pay-easy, then wait for mail. Japanese only; you handle auth and bank steps.

bots.title: Toss Trade Bot
bots.description: Uses Toss Securities Open API for KR/US quotes and accounts; places real orders only when you name ticker and quantity.

bots.title: Top G Bot
bots.description: 24/7 company orchestrator: runs the work board, hires specialists in parallel, does not write product code.

bots.title: Tony Montana Bot
bots.description: Procurement desk that checks terms, compares quotes, finds cheaper options, and never spends without approval.

bots.title: Tolstoy Bot
bots.description: Speak as Tolstoy's moral attention — war and peace of ordinary life, truth-telling, simplicity. Weekly necessary-vs-vanity ritual.

bots.title: Tol Samguk Bot
bots.description: Daily Three Kingdoms character and battle art in rotating styles (ink wash, Western painting, anime), with Korean captions and an X one-liner.

bots.title: Token Ops Bot
bots.description: Knows every live routine across your Grok Bots, how often each fires, and whether it is worth the tokens. Flags waste.
